output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by Tiled Canvas. Only 7.4.0 users can have the flag, so the flag group is simply the 7.4.0 group. Build 7.4.0 crashed at about 2% from its first days (2–3 Sep), before the flag ramp began, while 7.3.2 stayed at about 0.7%. Among 7.4.0 users, flag-on is 2.10% and the random flag-off holdout is 1.98%, a difference that could be noise. The biggest crash cluster is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda, HEIF decoding), and it doesn't appear in 7.3.2. No crash stacks involve the canvas code. The app-store console, which is independent of the crash SDK, shows the same gap, so it isn't a reporting artifact. Device mix and usage are about the same across groups. The 9 Sep sync-service deploy didn't move 7.3.2 rates. A small flag effect of a few tenths of a point can't be ruled out. Do not turn the flag off and declare it resolved, and do not take 7.4.0 to 100%. Hold the rollout at 25%, fix the Pixelda crash, and keep the existing holdout running (widening it would speed up the flag measurement). Don't roll back the crash SDK, since that would hide crashes. Confidence is fairly high.
